verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm that serves founders, so the International Entrepreneur Rule is a fair question for it. Its pages document NIW, H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E and PERM services, but nothing mentions entrepreneur parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds. A general mention of serving founders and helping them choose a path does not count as documenting this pathway.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
